hero.title: Workforce Solutions That Help Your Business Succeed
hero.subtitle: Globuss Solutions & Co. GmbH provides reliable manpower and skilled workforce solutions to companies across Germany and Europe. Through structured recruitment and compliant staffing models, we ensure you have the right professionals at the right time.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your Trusted Workforce Partner
about.description: Globuss Solutions & Co. GmbH is a Berlin-based manpower and workforce services provider specializing in recruitment, personnel placement, and flexible staffing solutions. We support businesses in healthcare, industrial, logistics, and service sectors with qualified, job-ready professionals, delivered in full compliance with labor and regulatory requirements.
about.mission: Our goal is to build long-term workforce partnerships that enable sustainable business growth.
about.history.title: Our History
about.history.description: Founded with a vision to bridge the gap between skilled professionals and businesses in need, Globuss Solutions has grown from a small recruitment agency to a comprehensive workforce solutions provider. Our journey has been marked by continuous improvement, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to quality.
about.team.title: Our Team
about.team.description: Our team consists of experienced HR professionals, industry specialists, and dedicated support staff who work together to deliver exceptional workforce solutions. Each team member brings unique expertise and a shared commitment to client success.
about.values.title: Our Values

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Comprehensive Workforce Solutions
services.intro: We offer a full spectrum of workforce solutions designed to meet the diverse needs of modern businesses. From temporary staffing to permanent placement, our services are tailored to your specific requirements.
services.manpower.title: Skilled Manpower Supply
services.manpower.description: Qualified professionals tailored to your operational needs
services.manpower.details: We source and deploy qualified professionals tailored to your specific operational requirements. Our rigorous vetting process ensures you receive skilled workers ready to contribute from day one. Whether you need specialists for a specific project or general workforce support, we deliver.
services.recruitment.title: Recruitment & Personnel Placement
services.recruitment.description: Right talent for the right role
services.recruitment.details: Our recruitment specialists identify, screen, and match candidates to your open positions. We handle the entire hiring process from job posting to final placement, ensuring cultural fit and skill alignment.
services.staffing.title: Temporary & Long-Term Staffing
services.staffing.description: Flexible solutions for peak demand and continuity
services.staffing.details: Whether you need temporary staff for seasonal peaks or permanent employees for growth, our flexible staffing solutions scale with your business needs. We manage contracts, payroll, and compliance.
services.compliance.title: Compliance-Focused Solutions
services.compliance.description: Aligned with legal and regulatory standards
services.compliance.details: All our workforce solutions comply with German labor laws, EU regulations, and industry-specific requirements. We handle documentation, contracts, and regulatory compliance so you can focus on your core business.
services.consulting.title: HR Consulting
services.consulting.details: Beyond placement, we offer strategic HR consulting to help you optimize your workforce structure, improve retention, and plan for future growth.
services.training.title: Training & Development
services.training.details: We provide training programs to ensure placed professionals meet your specific requirements and continue to develop their skills throughout their engagement.
